FestieFestie

Plan your festival with your crew.

Free, for iPhone. No ads, no tracking.

What you can do
Your scheduleYour crew's picksMeetupsTotem photosLocation only when you chooseWorks without signalNo ads, no trackingYour scheduleYour crew's picksMeetupsTotem photosLocation only when you chooseWorks without signalNo ads, no tracking

What you can do

  • Your schedule

    Pick the sets you want to see; Festie flags clashes, and the map shows what is up next on each stage.

    Clash

  • Your crew's picks

    Create a crew, invite friends with a 6-character code or a link, and see which sets everyone picked.

    10:30 · LakesideAJMSK7Q2PM

  • Meetups

    Plan a meetup with a time, a stage or a pin on the festival map, and an optional totem photo so your crew can spot where to meet.

    11:05

  • Location only when you choose

    Share your location with the crew you choose, for 1, 4 or 8 hours or until you stop (24 hours at most), and only while Festie is open. It is visible to your crew for at most 15 minutes after the last update, then deleted.

    1 h4 h8 h

  • Works without signal

    Schedules, crews and meetups are saved on your phone and sync when you are back online, and you can download the festival map.

    No signalSaved on your phoneSynced

Private by design

  • No ads, no tracking, and no analytics, crash-reporting or advertising SDKs.
  • Photos are stripped of their location and camera details before they leave your phone.
  • Your own location dot on the map stays on your phone.
  • Festie does not access your contacts or your microphone.
  • You can delete your account at any time in Settings.

Read the privacy policy

Help

For help with Festie, see the Support page or email support@joinfestie.com.
